subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------AFL.DY.-----AFI.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(I)-39. Near its end the preceding section states 'either we meet the responsibility of the next cycle or be prepared to become the effects of dynamic change.' The opening prose of MP(I)-39 declares: 'the realness of the changing political reality — and its relationship to creativity — proposes a great deal of research and responsibility — and more than that, implies actual functioning on the physical universe level. And no one is excluded, not even the people who call themselves "artists."' The crossing diagrams the three-axis structure that exclusion-of-no-one names: (D)IST-F (the dynamics of isolated focus — focused activity as actually performed) is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) which is in turn crossed with AFI (affinity insight). IST-F sits on the left with the subject-arrow; its line bends and rises to AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree), which sits at a peak at top-center, and runs on down to COS-P (cosmic particulars) at the lower-right. AFL-DY, the title's middle term, is not labeled in the drawing. ALT-F (alternative functionalism) rises from, and LANG-DY (language dynamics) drops from, the IST-F–AFI-1 stretch, so both read from AFI-1; PER-TR (perceived transformation) rises from the AFI-1–COS-P stretch, so it reads from COS-P. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) hangs centrally below, connected to AFI-1 via a *dashed* edge. Structural argument: when isolated-focus is crossed with affinity-dynamics-as-middle and affinity-insight-as-partner, the ALT-F branch off the AFI-1 stretch is what ties alternative-functionalism to affinity-insight. The dashed edge AFI-1 → CULT-INFO-DY amplifies some aspect of affinity-insight.
